# FutureShell WebAssembly source

`demo.cpp`, `app.js`, `styles.css`, and `index.html` are the web demo sources. The distribution copy of `app.js` starts on DT; `smoke.html` checks startup, Home, and the subapps.

Serve the ready-to-run files from `../../../ports/webasm/site`. To recompile WebAssembly, run the original `projects/phoneapps/htmldemo/build.bash` in the repository, then run `python3 dist/rebuild.py` to refresh this distribution.
